description: This file defines a generic Java class 'Versioned' that encapsulates a versioned object with methods to update and check versions. It is used to manage versioned entries of payloads, supporting concurrency control or version tracking.

classes.name: Versioned
classes.description: A generic class representing a versioned entity with capabilities to update based on version matching, useful for concurrency and version control.

methods.name: Versioned
methods.description: Constructor initializing a versioned object with specified version and value.

methods.name: Versioned
methods.description: Constructor creating a versioned object with a value and an auto-generated UUID as its version.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Creates a new versioned instance with new content if the provided resource version matches the current version or is empty.

methods.name: isVersionMatch
methods.description: Checks if the provided resource version matches the current version or is empty.
